title: 第23章 功法成第24章 魂归
content_zh:
张皓旸凭借强大的领悟天赋，按照白虎杀伐六叠剑诀图示将第一式足足演练数十万次后，终于将白虎杀伐六叠剑第一式出剑入世练至小成。
不要小看第一式出剑入世只是小成之境，剑招朴实无华，只是一拔剑一挥剑再普通不过，但是拔剑挥剑之间，威力却是巨大无比。
施展小成的出剑入世则是立即出现四道剑气、四道剑光、四道剑影将对方笼罩在内，每一道剑光都令对手心寒避无可避，每一道剑影都让对手如影随形躲无可躲，每一道剑气都足以将对手斩杀。
一般同境界武者在这一招之下根本无招架之力，会直接落败甚至身死，凭借此招，张皓旸可以至少越两个境界杀敌，就是说以他目前筑基境一层巅峰的修为可以筑基境三层巅峰的武者对抗甚至是斩杀。
白虎杀伐六叠剑第一式出剑入世小成威力固然强大，但是练习这一招张皓旸也是付出巨大的代价，不管是体力、精力都已经是到了一个极限，就连他的神识都感觉有些恍惚。
依靠过人的天赋，不屈的毅力，张皓旸经过数十万次的练习，克服体力、精力以及神魂的极限，终于在五天后将白虎杀伐六叠剑第一式出剑入世炼至大成。
塔内一天，外界才只过去十分之一天。
现在塔内时间过去五天，外界也就是才过去半天时间。
张皓旸用了五天时间将白虎杀伐六叠剑这一至高剑术的第一式出剑入世炼至大成。
这种速度即便是放在外界来看，用五天的时间将这一招炼至大成也是绝无仅有的！
也是一个奇迹！
这是一般武者根本做不到的，但是张皓旸却做到了，不但如此，他还对只将白虎杀伐六叠剑第一式出剑入世炼至大成不满足，他要更加强大，他要强大到能保护自己的家人。
在这种信念的坚持下，他克服身体疲惫的极限，再次投入到剑招的练习中。
张皓旸继续练习、继续推敲，将出剑位置、时机、方向完美结合，又经过他大约数十万次的练习，终于将第一式出剑入世炼至巅峰，距离出神入化境界只差一步之遥；他本想借此绝佳机会将白虎杀伐六叠剑的第一式出剑入世直接修炼至出神入化之境，但是在经过一段时间的练习后，他却发现自己对这一剑招的领悟并没有再精进。
当张皓旸在将白虎杀伐六叠剑的第一式出剑入世炼至巅峰后，不管他再如何努力、再如何用心去练习白虎杀伐六叠剑的第一式出剑入世，也无法使他的剑术再有所精进。
这时张皓旸才意识到，剑术的提升仅凭这样独自练习还远远不够，还需要在真正的搏斗中去感悟，只有在面对生死考验时方能激发身体的强大潜能，进一步提升自己的剑术水平。
在目前这种平和、静好的环境下，将白虎杀伐六叠剑第一式出剑入世练至巅峰已经是极限，他不再苛求，想进一步提升剑术就需要到外界历练才行，需要生死考验方可激发潜能，更进一步。
想通这些，张皓旸也不再执着于将白虎杀伐六叠剑的第一式出剑入世炼至出神入化，而是开始修炼第二式挑剑四方。
在经过大约三天后他将第二式挑剑四方练至入门，在此后的一段时间里他虽然继续努力练习，但是第二式挑剑四方没有再有所精进。
于是他就停止白虎杀伐六叠剑的修炼改为修炼朱雀六变轻身术。

随即张皓旸就拿出朱雀六变轻身术进行研究，书中同样有详尽注释和精美图示。
图中身影衣袂飘飘，迈出诡异步伐，张皓旸照图示和讲解不断迈出步伐练习。
朱雀六变轻身术共分六变，步伐轻盈、飘忽不定，诡异步伐，玄之又玄，一变比一变速度更快。
朱雀六变轻身术第一变为雀之变，第二变为幻之变，第三变潜之变，第四变为御之变，第五变为地之变，第六变为天之变。
朱雀六变轻身术每一变的步法变化都是诡异莫测，玄奥无比，除此之外每一变的速度都是前一变速度的四倍。
第一变的速度为五丈每瞬，第二变的速度是第一变速度的四倍，就是二十丈每瞬，而第三变的速度是第二变速度的四倍，就是八十丈每瞬，第四变的速度则是第三变速度的四倍，就是三百二十丈每瞬，第五变的速度又是第四变的速度的四倍，就是一千八百十丈每瞬，第六变的速度，一步踏出则是五千一百二十丈，炼至第六变则犹如缩地成寸。
经过无数次步法的练习，大约二十天后，张皓旸就将朱雀六变轻身术第一层雀之变炼成。
上一刻张皓旸还在原处，下一刻张皓旸已经在五丈之外。
将白虎杀伐六叠剑第一式出剑入世练至巅峰，第二式挑剑四方练至入门境界；将朱雀六变轻身术第一层雀之变炼成，混沌塔内所用的时间已经过去了二十三天，张皓旸就利用剩余的七天时间对青龙锻体术及玄武丹经基础篇进行了详细的研究。
张皓旸虽然因为暂时没有龙属性妖兽的精血导致无法淬炼身体进而无法修炼青龙锻体术，但是张皓旸却是凭借过目不忘的天赋将青龙锻体术中关于锻体的要求、锻体方法、身体的反应、坚硬程度变化等内容熟记于心。
青龙锻体术，成长性武技。
需借助龙属性妖兽的三滴精血对身体进行淬炼。
青龙锻体术共分三层，第一层古铜之体，以炼皮为主，古铜之体炼成则皮肤呈古铜色，坚硬程度犹如古铜，远超高阶妖兽的皮肤，可抵抗一般刀剑等袭击而不伤；第二层是金刚之体，以炼骨为主，金刚之体炼成则皮、骨皆呈金黄色，犹如金刚，刀枪不坏。
金刚之体炼成可觉醒龙属性妖兽的本体和功法传承；第三层是青龙之体，以炼血为主，青龙之体炼成则血液呈青红之色，皮、骨、血皆达青龙本体，水火不侵、刀劈斧砍不伤一丝。
青龙之体炼成时就可觉醒龙属性妖兽的血脉力量。
除此之外，张皓旸还对玄武丹经中描述的各类药草、奇珍异果的外形、根须、属性、治疗症状；丹药的炼制方法、步骤、时机把握以及天材地宝的形状、功效等内容全部默记在心中。

content_en:
Zhang Haoyang relied on his powerful comprehension talent and practiced the first move hundreds of thousands of times according to the diagram of the White Tiger Killing Six-fold Sword Technique, and finally mastered the first move of the White Tiger Killing Six-fold Sword to a small degree.
Don't underestimate the fact that the first sword move is just a small achievement. The sword moves are simple and unpretentious. Just drawing and swinging the sword is ordinary, but the power between drawing and swinging the sword is huge.
When Xiao Cheng's Sword Drawing is used, four rays of sword energy, four rays of sword light, and four rays of sword shadow immediately appear, covering the opponent. Each ray of sword light makes the opponent feel chilled and unable to avoid it.
Generally, warriors at the same level would not be able to parry under this move, and would be directly defeated or even killed. With this move, Zhang Haoyang can kill the enemy at least two levels away. In other words, with his current cultivation at the peak of the first level of the Foundation Establishment Realm, he can fight against or even kill the warriors at the peak of the third level of the Foundation Establishment Realm.
The first move of White Tiger's Killing Six-fold Sword is powerful, but Zhang Haoyang also paid a huge price to practice this move. Both physical strength and energy have reached the limit, and even his consciousness feels a little dazed.
Relying on his extraordinary talent and unyielding perseverance, Zhang Haoyang practiced hundreds of thousands of times, overcoming the limits of physical strength, energy and soul, and finally mastered the first move of the White Tiger Killing Six-fold Sword to enter the world five days later.
One day inside the tower, only one-tenth of the day passes outside.
Five days have passed inside the tower, and only half a day has passed outside.
Zhang Haoyang spent five days perfecting the White Tiger Killing Six-fold Sword, the first form of the supreme swordsmanship.
Even if you look at this speed from the outside world, it takes five days to refine this move to perfection, which is unique!
Also a miracle!
This is something that ordinary warriors simply cannot do, but Zhang Haoyang has done it. Not only that, he is not satisfied with just using the first form of the White Tiger Killing Six-fold Sword to enter the world and refine it to perfection. He wants to be stronger. He wants to be strong enough to protect his family.
With the persistence of this belief, he overcame the limit of physical fatigue and once again devoted himself to the practice of sword moves.
Zhang Haoyang continued to practice and refine, and perfectly combined the position, timing, and direction of the sword. After practicing for hundreds of thousands of times, he finally reached the peak of the first sword move, which was only one step away from the realm of transcendence. He originally wanted to take this opportunity to directly practice the first sword move of the White Tiger Killing Six-fold Sword to the realm of transcendence. However, after a period of practice, he found that his understanding of this sword move had not improved any more.
When Zhang Haoyang reached the peak of the first sword movement of the White Tiger to kill the Six-fold Sword, no matter how hard he tried and how diligently he practiced the first sword movement of the White Tiger to kill the Six-Stack Sword, he could not improve his swordsmanship any further.
Only then did Zhang Haoyang realize that it was not enough to improve his swordsmanship just by practicing alone. He also needed to gain insights in real fights. Only when facing the test of life and death can he stimulate his body's powerful potential and further improve his swordsmanship.
In the current peaceful and quiet environment, it is already the limit to practice the first sword move of White Tiger Killing Six-fold Sword to the peak. He is no longer demanding. If he wants to further improve his swordsmanship, he needs to experience the outside world. He needs life and death tests to stimulate his potential and go further.
After thinking about this, Zhang Haoyang no longer obsessed with perfecting the first sword movement of White Tiger Killing Six-fold Sword, but began to practice the second sword movement.
After about three days, he practiced the second style of sword picking in four directions to the beginning. Although he continued to practice hard for a period of time, he did not make any improvement in the second style of sword picking in four directions.
So he stopped practicing the White Tiger Killing Six-fold Sword and instead practiced the Suzaku Six-Transformation Lightening Technique.Zhang Haoyang then took out the Suzaku Six Transformations Light Body Technique to study it. The book also has detailed annotations and exquisite illustrations.
The figure in the picture has fluttering clothes and takes strange steps. Zhang Haoyang keeps practicing the steps according to the illustrations and explanations.
Suzaku's Six Transformations Light Body Technique is divided into six transformations. The steps are light, erratic, and strange. The steps are mysterious and mysterious. Each transformation is faster than the last.
The Suzaku Six Transformations Light Body Technique: The first one is the bird transformation, the second one is the illusion transformation, the third one is the latent transformation, the fourth one is the imperial transformation, the fifth one is the earth transformation, and the sixth one is the heaven transformation.
The footwork changes of each change in Suzaku's Six Changes of Light Body Technique are unpredictable and mysterious. In addition, the speed of each change is four times the speed of the previous change.
The speed of the first change is five times the speed of the first change, which is twenty feet per instant. The speed of the third change is four times the speed of the second change, which is eighty feet per instant. The speed of the fourth change is the third speed. Four times, that is, three hundred and twenty feet per instant. The speed of the fifth transformation is four times that of the fourth transformation, which is one thousand eight hundred and twenty feet per instant. The speed of the sixth transformation is 5,120 feet in one step. The sixth transformation is like shrinking the earth into an inch.
After practicing countless footwork, Zhang Haoyang completed the first level of the Suzaku Six Transformations Light Body Technique about twenty days later.
One moment Zhang Haoyang was still in the same place, and the next moment Zhang Haoyang was already five feet away.
He practiced the first form of the White Tiger Killing Six-fold Sword to reach the peak of the world, and the second form of carrying the sword in all directions to the entry level; he refined the first level of the Suzaku Six Transformations Light Body Technique, the bird transformation. Twenty-three days have passed in the Chaos Tower, and Zhang Haoyang used the remaining seven days to conduct detailed research on the basics of the Qinglong Body Training Technique and the Xuanwu Dan Sutra.
Although Zhang Haoyang was unable to temper his body and practice the Blue Dragon Body Building Technique because he temporarily lacked the essence and blood of the dragon attribute monster, Zhang Haoyang relied on his gift of photographic memory to memorize the requirements, methods, body reactions, changes in hardness, etc. in the Green Dragon Body Building Technique.
Qinglong body training technique, a growth martial skill.
The body needs to be tempered with the help of three drops of blood essence from the dragon attribute monster.
The Qinglong body training technique is divided into three layers. The first layer is the bronze body, which is mainly based on skin refining. When the bronze body is refined, the skin will be bronze-colored and as hard as bronze. It is far superior to the skin of high-level monsters and can withstand attacks from ordinary swords without being injured. The second layer is the diamond body, which is mainly based on bone refining. When the diamond body is refined, the skin and bones will be golden yellow, just like a diamond, and are indestructible with swords and guns.
The body of the Vajra can be refined to awaken the body and inheritance of dragon attribute monsters; the third level is the body of the blue dragon, which is mainly based on blood refining. When the body of the blue dragon is refined, the blood will be green-red, and the skin, bones, and blood will all reach the level of the green dragon. It is invulnerable to water and fire, and will not be injured by knives and axes.
When the body of the blue dragon is refined, the bloodline power of the dragon attribute monster can be awakened.
In addition, Zhang Haoyang also memorized the appearance, roots, properties, and treatment symptoms of various medicinal herbs and rare fruits described in the Xuanwu Alchemy Sutra; the refining methods, steps, timing of the elixirs, and the shapes and effects of heavenly materials and earthly treasures.
